published_prior_art.cite: CapitaoMiniconiGassiatLehericy2025 identifies the latent signal and errors, but not the outcome-weighted signed channel or causal bridge under open zero sets.
KatoSasaki2019 gives a conventional-operator EIV regression band; no verified source gives this blind open-zero causal band.
Low1997 supplies the testing-to-length device, not the fixed-noisy-treatment-marginal Bernoulli ADRF construction.
No verified comparator matches simultaneous honest causal-band achievability and the fixed-marginal all-honest converse in the blind open-zero model.
Low1997 and CapitaoMiniconiGassiatLehericy2025 do not characterize adaptation across these blind operator-strength subclasses.

soundness_flags.label: ass:local-modulus
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited CapitaoMiniconiGassiatLehericy2025 identification result assumes only coordinate independence of the errors, not the stated uniform local lower modulus; retag this quantitative class restriction as novel with an applicability justification or replace its citation.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 4141, Abstract and opening identification statement
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article states identification with no assumption on the noise beyond coordinate independence; its identifying theorem therefore does not support the proposal's named uniform local characteristic-function-modulus assumption.

The paper constructs asymptotically valid uniform confidence bands for EIV regression using deconvolution kernels and multiplier bootstrap with unknown error handled through validation or repeated-measurement information.

The main model assumes a known measurement-error characteristic function and develops ADRF identification, estimation, and pointwise inference, so it is an accurate known-error benchmark rather than a subsuming blind-replicate comparator.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Retag ass:local-modulus as a novel quantitative identification-strength restriction and add a concrete measurement-error family plus an empirical diagnostic explaining when its fixed constants are credible.
State a focused comparison corollary showing exactly how the signed-channel recovery specializes to the known-error Huang–Zhang functional and differs from the CML latent-density theorem.
Develop the spectral-adaptation question into a named separation theorem or impossibility result for a nontrivial pair of polynomial-envelope subclasses.

recommended_next_step: Revise the unsupported standard-tagged local-modulus assumption, then advance the otherwise field-grade proposal to Stage 0.
